messages.subject: Penrose v Caldervale - Advice on Merits (PRIVILEGED)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Tom,

My advice on the merits is attached. In short: a strong claim for the Outstanding Sums (I put recovery at 70-75%) and good prospects of defeating most of the counterclaim, provided the expert evidence isolates Caldervale's contribution to the shortfall. I recommend pleading Milestone 4 primarily as a debt with damages in the alternative, and a mediation after exchange of expert reports.

Harriet Stanford
Eldon Chambers
